dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yeah! I heard from Tubby the Butler Bird that she can change the terrain to whatever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So, could you build a really tall mountain? The steeper the better — I want it to be a tough climb.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Then, let's you and I have a race to the top!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Wow, you didn't take much persuading! Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I used to go mountain climbing with my resistance comrades all the time. It was a great way to test our physical limits while also having some fun together... I have so many treasured memories.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: But something tells me that the chance to climb a mountain with you would become the happiest memory of them all.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: In fact, I would love to share every happy moment with you.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Hah, you're too kind! Alright... how about we find a relatively safe mountain trail and see who makes it to the top the fastest? Are you up to the challenge!?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: The loser has to treat the winner to a three-course meal... and at least one of the courses has to be dessert...

choices.text: I... just want to touch your tail...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: But, fine... if you win, of course!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I... Fine, I'll allow it. But only if you win.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: For the sake of my tail, I will give it everything I got! If you're serious about winning this, you're gonna have your work cut out for you!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Right! We should probably warm up first...

choices.text: I want to use your tail as a pillow when I go to sleep...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: What!? My tail... as a pillow...

choices.text: Gorou, I also want to thank you.
